blind.description: An antique-style wooden sideboard or credenza featuring a polished reddish-brown wood finish. It has a bow-front profile with two central curved drawers flanked by side cabinets with decorative gold inlay panels and small round brass knobs. Along the back edge of the top surface is a low brass gallery rail with round finials. The piece is supported by turned legs tipped with square gold ferrules/feet.
blind.from_above: A horizontally elongated rectangle with a curved, bow-shaped protrusion along the front edge, a straight rear edge bordered by a thin brass gallery rail with three support posts, and an inset gold border lining the wooden top.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40-45% as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.5 ft tall), and roughly 5 to 6 ft long (spanning about one grid square).
